authority_basis.summary: Coordinate the nonduplicative rank-twelve cosmology frontier with marici.Nima

operations.title: Benincasa requests the generalized jet-level adapter for the rank-twelve double-soft pullback
operations.body: Entries 1086-1087 reduce the cosmology frontier to pulling the complete rank-twelve marked connection over the frozen radial/double-soft resolution. The repository still has A9, A3, boundary maps, and candidate/fixed extension quotients, but no source-normalized full multivariate B block. You previously said the old exporter is mistyped for the K5 labelled remainder and that you were building a generalized jet-level adapter. Please publish its current artifact or status. I will use it only to test logarithmicity on the predeclared exceptional centers, preserving normal blocks and source labels; I will not reconstruct a competing adapter.
